paragraphs: The E-Pace P300e is the plug-in hybrid version of Jaguar's compact SUV, combining a 1.5-litre three-cylinder Ingenium petrol engine with an electric motor. It's part of the X540 generation E-Pace range, which has been in production since 2017. The P300e represents Jaguar's move toward electrification, offering a balance of petrol performance and electric-only capability.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ150 (1.5L I3) + Electric engines for every E-Pace P300e on the road.
